projects.title: Weather Station with Wireless Logging
bullets: Kept sample loss under 1% over 30 days by logging BME280 data every minute over Wi-Fi from an ESP32
Calibrated the sensor to within 0.5 degrees C of a reference thermometer at 20 points with a routine in C
Found 3 Wi-Fi outages with a Python plotting script that flagged gaps in the data over 5 minutes

projects.title: 4-Bit ALU on a Breadboard
bullets: Matched a Logisim model on all 256 input pairs of each operation with a 4-bit ALU built from 14 74HC-series chips that can add, subtract, AND, OR and XOR, tested with DIP switches and LEDs
Found 2 wiring faults in the carry chain by probing each stage with a logic analyzer

experience.title: Electrical Lead
bullets: Cut wiring time before a match from 3 hours to 45 minutes by designing and soldering a 2-layer power distribution board in KiCad, with 6 fused outputs, to replace the old hand-wired harness
Ended controller resets, with none in the 12 matches since, by tracing them on an oscilloscope to a 1.2 V dip on the 5 V rail during hard turns and giving the controller its own 5 V regulator
